instrument: Rohde & Schwarz DC power supply (NGL200 / NGM200 / NGE100 / HMP)
source: Transcribed from the R&S NGL200/NGM200 Power Supply Series User Manual (1178.8736.02), with the NGE100 User Manual and the HMP Series SCPI Programmers Manual adding the older lines. Cross-checked against pymeasure rohdeschwarz hmp. For a time only the NGL200/NGM200 manual was kept in datasheets/, and 58 of these 445 entries could not be traced to a document that was still here — the TRIGger:...:DIO<IO> tree, SYSTem:COMMunicate:WLAN, SYSTem:TEST, [SOURce:]VOLTage:EASYramp, and singles like SYSTem:VERSion? and DIAGnostic:SERVice:FWUP. The guess written here was that an NGE100 is too basic and an HMP too old to be their home. That guess was wrong. Both manuals were fetched on 11 August 2026 and 55 of the 58 are in them: the whole DIO trigger tree, the WLAN commands, SYSTem:TEST, EASYramp, ARBitrary and the socket DHCP pair are all in the NGE100 User Manual, and *RCL, *SAV, SYSTem:MIX and SYSTem:VERSion? are in the HMP. The three left over are STATus:QUEStionable:INSTrument:ISUMmary:CONDition?, :ENABle and :ENABle?, written without the channel suffix that all three manuals print — they document ISUMmary<ch> only, and this catalog already carries the suffixed forms beside these. Whether an unsuffixed ISUMmary defaults to channel 1, as SCPI convention suggests, needs one of these supplies on a bench to answer, and there is none here.
